data_basis: EU-SILC data (2024 cross-sectional wave; 2023 income reference year), run through EUROMOD.

fingerprint_check.conclusion: The committed surface's unit count equals the EU-SILC 2024 household count exactly, not the 2,397-household synthetic validation floor (common/build_summary.json).

engine.version: EUROMOD v3.8.6 (matched engine; enforced by assert_matched_engine)

converter: europe/Spain/model/es_real/convert_full.py :: convert_es_2024_full (reads the EU-SILC data files read-only)
build_script: europe/<Country>/model/build_grid.py (CC_CFG wires the real converter; the EUROMOD dataset id is a label, the input data is the converted EU-SILC data)
emsd_difference_note: Run on the EU-SILC data directly, NOT EUROMOD's own bundled input dataset (the EMSD), which applies EUROMOD's own harmonisation and imputation. The effect of this input-preparation difference on results is UNQUANTIFIED and cannot be verified without the EMSD, which this project does not use; neither equivalent to a standard EUROMOD run nor inferior, only prepared differently.
corroboration: The build report for Spain documents the same counts, and ES is classified as built on EU-SILC data.
how_to_reverify: Count rows-minus-header of UDB_cES24D.csv at the source path (households) and compare to this surface's meta.n_units; they are equal. Requires the licensed data (held outside this repository).
generated: 2026-07-04 (read-only measurement of the EU-SILC household counts + committed surface meta)

input_conversion.rule: every input variable a live 2023 policy reads, for which the EUROMOD input data codebook publishes a recipe for this country and whose source fields the public EU-SILC user database carries, is populated from that recipe
input_conversion.populated_in_this_pass: poa00/poacm/poanc and psuwd00/psuwdcm/psuot decomposed per the codebook; bunct and bunnc split on PY092G and PY093G; the read benefits bhl, bed, bho, bfa, bsa and bchot; yot; the housing costs xhcrt, xhcmomi, xhcmomc, xhc and xhcot; xpp; kfb; the survey lines tad, tis, yds and tscer; loc, lcs and dec
input_conversion.not_populated: national-SILC and production variables, PL111A which the release ships empty, recipes that stop short of a value, and the three asset variables, which are reported rather than derived
input_conversion.reproduction_note: this surface does NOT reproduce the 2026-08-01 surface and is not meant to: the inputs changed, so the outputs changed. It is validated against the published EUROMOD baseline instead, before and after
